senses.gloss: m. (סִיעַ) help, assistance. Y. Sabb. XVIII, end, 16ᶜ (ref. to מסעדין, Mish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:3">Sabb. XVIII, 3</cite>) <he>אי זהו הס׳</he> wherein does the assistance (rendered to travailing animals) consist? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:4">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>ומה אם הרוחות … לשום ס׳ צריכין ס׳ אנו שנבראנו לס׳ וכ׳</he> when the spirits that are not made dependent on assistance, require assistance, how much more do we (human beings) who are made dependent on assistance &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:4">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>עזרך … יסעדך</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 20:3">Ps. XX, 3</cite>) <he>עזרה וס׳ וכ׳</he> help and assistance come from Zion.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>וכי לסִיּוּעָן של וכ׳</he> does the Lord need the assistance of the nations?—
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 43:6">Ex. R. s. 43</cite> <he>עשו לך ס׳</he> they have given thee (the Lord) an assistant (in the golden calf); a. e.
